Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the maternal grandmother was Maria Laskarina, confusing the paternal line (Béla IV and Maria Laskarina as Stephen V’s parents) with the maternal line. This contradicted the verified evidence that Constantine’s mother is Anna of Hungary, whose mother is Elizabeth the Cuman; thus the correct maternal grandmother is Elizabeth the Cuman.
